Title: Shogun
Writer: James Clavell (based on the novel by)
Actors: Cosmo Jarvis, Hiroyuki Sanada, Anna Sawai
Plot: When a mysterious European ship is found marooned in a nearby Japanese fishing village, Lord Yoshii Toranaga discovers secrets that could tip the scales of power and devastate his enemies.
Awards: Won 18 Primetime Emmys. 92 wins & 76 nominations total
